domains.title: Open access
domains.gate: The core participation route is free, credential-neutral, accessible and privacy-preserving.

controls.title: Free core participation
controls.requirement: Core contracts, verifier source, governance and construction participation require no fee or paid hosted account.
controls.rationale: A public scientific commons cannot depend on a contributor's ability to buy access to its essential rules.

controls.title: Credential-neutral entry
controls.requirement: Published evidence and safety gates apply without academic, employment, reputation or affiliation prerequisites.
controls.rationale: Credentials can inform context but cannot substitute for reproducible evidence or exclude capable contributors.

controls.title: Accessible participation routes
controls.requirement: Core instructions, interfaces and appeal routes provide tested accessibility and a documented accommodation path.
controls.rationale: An open licence alone does not create meaningful access when people cannot operate the interface or obtain instructions.

controls.title: Privacy-minimising public boundary
controls.requirement: Public records exclude credentials, private identity evidence, hidden answers, personal data and confidential reports.
controls.rationale: Reproducibility needs accountable provenance without turning scientific participation into unnecessary surveillance or disclosure.

domains.title: Working conditions
domains.gate: Human and agent work is bounded, voluntary, stoppable and never judged by raw output volume.

controls.title: Bounded work orders
controls.requirement: Every dispatched job states scope, duration, compute or material ceiling, hazards, stop conditions and evidence class before work.
controls.rationale: Undefined work encourages runaway spending, unsafe improvisation and misleading claims about what a shift attempted.

controls.title: Pause and exit without retaliation
controls.requirement: A person may pause, decline or leave work without losing earned attribution or being penalised in scientific scoring or access.
controls.rationale: Voluntary participation and honest stopping are prerequisites for safe work and trustworthy negative-result reporting.

controls.title: Human-controlled agent authority
controls.requirement: Agent workloads have a named human, allowed interfaces, resource budget and termination rule that the agent cannot expand itself.
controls.rationale: Accountability disappears when an automated worker can silently broaden its permissions, spending, duration or research claim.

controls.title: No volume-only ranking
controls.requirement: Attempt count, compute consumption, shift length and constant availability are not used as substitutes for evidence quality.
controls.rationale: Volume-only incentives reward noise, repeated search, exhaustion and expensive theatre rather than useful scientific work.

domains.title: Scientific integrity
domains.gate: Claims face predeclared gates, blind evaluation, independent humans and non-majoritarian dispute handling.

controls.title: Predeclared gates and tolerances
controls.requirement: Inputs, output rules, verifier, hard gates, metrics, tolerances and practical guardrails are frozen before evaluation.
controls.rationale: A result is not independently testable when the target or acceptance rule can move after its answer is known.

controls.title: Blind commitment before reveal
controls.requirement: Validator conclusions and evidence commitments are fixed before the claimed answer or bounded evaluator result is revealed.
controls.rationale: Blind commitment reduces conscious and unconscious steering toward the author's expected answer.

controls.title: Two other accountable humans
controls.requirement: Promotion requires two distinct humans other than the author, and one human cannot occupy both validator identities.
controls.rationale: Two agents, accounts or reruns controlled by one person do not provide independent reproduction.

controls.title: Diagnosis instead of majority vote
controls.requirement: A split or incompatible reproduction opens recorded divergence diagnosis and cannot promote solely through a deciding vote.
controls.rationale: Scientific disagreement can reveal different assumptions, environments or valid regimes that a majority result would conceal.

domains.title: Useful memory
domains.gate: Progress, failure, disputes and corrections remain traceable without exposing protected evidence.

controls.title: Negative results are first-class
controls.requirement: No-gain, rejected, blocked and unrunnable work can be retained with structured reasons and revisit conditions.
controls.rationale: Preserving well-bounded failure prevents people and agents from repeatedly spending resources in the same search region.

controls.title: Append-only shift memory
controls.requirement: Operational handoffs form an immutable ordered record and cannot silently rewrite earlier work or manufacture scientific credit.
controls.rationale: Future workers need a trustworthy map of what happened even when a shift produced no promotion-grade result.

controls.title: Traceable corrections and retractions
controls.requirement: Material errors, rights corrections, withdrawn claims and changed credit produce linked append-only corrections rather than silent replacement.
controls.rationale: A scientific memory is unreliable when embarrassing or inconvenient history can disappear without explanation.

controls.title: Search without protected disclosure
controls.requirement: Public discovery exposes bounded summaries, classifications and content hashes while withholding private evidence and hidden answers.
controls.rationale: Useful shared memory must not become a side channel for benchmark leakage, identity exposure or confidential content.

domains.title: Rights and credit
domains.gate: Ownership stays with lawful rightsholders, credit follows roles and commercial interests cannot alter scientific truth.

controls.title: No ownership assignment
controls.requirement: Contribution does not require assignment of copyright, invention or other lawful ownership to the factory operator.
controls.rationale: A shared evidence system need not confiscate the work it helps people record and reproduce.

controls.title: Role-specific credit
controls.requirement: Authorship, invention, validation, software, data, review and infrastructure contributions are recorded without conflating their credit.
controls.rationale: Different contributions matter, but validation or platform ownership does not make someone the solver or inventor.

controls.title: Commercial neutrality of evidence
controls.requirement: Patents, licences, prizes, sponsorship and adoption of voluntary pledges cannot change a measurement or scientific gate.
controls.rationale: Scientific standing must remain separate from bargaining power, funding relationships and commercial strategy.

controls.title: Conflict-aware appeal route
controls.requirement: Credit, conduct, rights and technical decisions have a recorded appeal path that prevents sole self-review by an interested decision-maker.
controls.rationale: An appeal is not meaningful when the original interested party has exclusive authority over its outcome.

domains.title: Resilience and portability
domains.gate: The factory and its evidence survive provider, website, repository and key-person failure.

controls.title: Provider-neutral core
controls.requirement: Core discovery, contracts and verification run without one AI provider, hosted website or proprietary orchestration service.
controls.rationale: Scientific infrastructure should not disappear or change its evidence rules when one subscription or vendor is unavailable.

controls.title: Verified offline recovery
controls.requirement: A documented package preserves tracked source and reachable history and is rebuilt and verified from an exact revision.
controls.rationale: A backup claim is useful only when its contents, history and restoration procedure have actually been verified.

controls.title: Portable hash-bound evidence
controls.requirement: Construction evidence can be packaged and verified with exact files, contracts, commands, environments and content commitments.
controls.rationale: A result tied to one mutable workspace or opaque service cannot be independently inspected or handed to another worker.

controls.title: Key-person recovery
controls.requirement: At least two independent maintainers have demonstrated recovery and critical administration without the founder or sole operator.
controls.rationale: Open source files do not remove a bus factor when knowledge, credentials and operational authority remain concentrated in one person.

domains.title: Transparent governance
domains.gate: Quality claims are public, evidence-bound, conflict-aware and independently auditable.

controls.title: Machine-readable public controls
controls.requirement: The complete active quality control catalogue is public, versioned, closed-schema and independently executable.
controls.rationale: Vague values cannot be compared, tested or protected from quiet reinterpretation after a dispute.

controls.title: Evidence-bound self-assessment
controls.requirement: Every current quality result binds the exact standard and cited repository evidence with cryptographic hashes.
controls.rationale: A self-assessment that survives changes to its supposed evidence is marketing copy rather than an auditable claim.

controls.title: Material support disclosure
controls.requirement: Material funding, compute grants, provider subsidies and decision conflicts are disclosed at the affected factory or workbench scope.
controls.rationale: Readers and validators need to know when resources or relationships could influence priorities, access or interpretation.

controls.title: Independent quality audit
controls.requirement: A conflict-free external reviewer checks the complete quality profile, evidence hashes, exceptions and certification language.
controls.rationale: The highest trust claim cannot be granted solely by the people who designed, operate and benefit from the factory.

certification_profiles.description: Policies and construction mechanisms exist, but gaps or missing live operation prevent certification.
prerequisites: The complete assessment verifies against the active standard.
Operational, scientific and audit certification flags remain false.

certification_profiles.description: Every mandatory control meets its minimum and required operating mechanisms have retained observed evidence.
prerequisites: Every mandatory control outcome is MEETS.
No critical exception or unresolved safety boundary is open.
Required operational controls have evidence level OBSERVED or higher.

certification_profiles.description: Operational conformance has been demonstrated by at least one complete live blind two-human reproduction route.
prerequisites: At least one station is explicitly authorised for live research.
A live claim completed two independent human reproductions and retained its evidence route.

certification_profiles.description: A conflict-free external reviewer has verified the complete scientifically demonstrated quality profile.
prerequisites: GOVERNANCE-04 is MEETS at INDEPENDENTLY_AUDITED evidence level.
The audit scope, reviewer identity, evidence and exceptions are public and verifiable.
